note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1927: nominations received by W. J. Corner, clerk, 26 April 1927. No party labels printed. The council also had three co-opted members. Returned unopposed. Robert Anderson: no party label printed in 1927. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Portadown, Armagh County Council, 29 May 1924, printed 'U': Frontier Sentinel, 10 May 1924, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council. Five Contests. Fifteen Unopposed Returns")). His labels elsewhere differ (UUP x5, Independent Unionist x1).
